title: Classroom Scene 7 — School Routines
purpose: Support classroom routines, social language and functional comprehension.

sentenceModels: The child is raising a hand.
The child is giving the paper to the teacher.
The child is packing the bag.
The child is sitting at the desk.

adultSupport.focus: Use the scene for naming routines, following simple instructions and talking about classroom expectations.
starterPrompts: Who is giving the paper to the teacher?
Who is putting a book away?
Which child is ready at the desk?
expansionPrompts: Tell me what happens first and what happens next.
Which things belong in the backpack and which things belong on the shelf?

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
